instruction: Lift both the red tea-box with golden designs and the compact barcode scanner at once before scanning the red tea-box with golden designs.

source.instruction: Lift both the red tea-box with golden designs and the compact barcode scanner at once before scanning the red tea-box with golden designs.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the scanner, which was at x = -12 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the object, which was at x = +20 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper over scanner handle at (-12, -10, 94) and orient yaw to -55 degrees.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+18, +9, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the scanner

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -11, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper toward scanner handle and move right gripper over tea-box at (20, -15, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the scanner; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-10, +4, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -11, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -15, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate right gripper yaw to +35 degrees to match box angle and descend toward z=86.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -11, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -15, 86) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to grasp height z=79 on scanner handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, -8) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the scanner

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -11, 79) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (20, -15, 86) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to grasp height z=78 and close both grippers to grasp scanner and tea-box.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the scanner; closed the gripper (opening 0.32: holding the scanner); RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -11, 79) opening 0.32; RIGHT fingertips (20, -15, 78) opening 0.81; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift scanner with left arm to z=91 and clear space.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-5, +0, +13) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the scanner

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-17, -10, 91) opening 0.32; RIGHT fingertips (20, -15, 78) opening 0.83; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift tea-box with right arm to z=91 to complete dual lift.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+5, +0, +13) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-17, -10, 91) opening 0.32; RIGHT fingertips (25, -15, 91) opening 0.83; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm with tea-box closer to center at (8, -2) and rotate roll 90 degrees.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-17, +14, +0) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-17, -10, 91) opening 0.32; RIGHT fingertips (8, -2, 91) opening 0.82; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust right gripper pitch and yaw to orient tea-box face toward the left scanner.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +4) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-17, -10, 91) opening 0.32; RIGHT fingertips (7, -2, 95) opening 0.82; table z = 74
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-17, -10, 91) opening 0.32; RIGHT fingertips (7, -2, 95) opening 0.82; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm with scanner toward tea-box to (-9, -3, 94) and adjust roll.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+8, +8, +2) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the scanner

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-9, -3, 94) opening 0.32; RIGHT fingertips (7, -2, 95) opening 0.82; table z = 74
frames.plan: Pitch left gripper up to aim scanner head directly at tea-box barcode.
